name: Big 12 Cross Country Championships
where: Stillwater, OK · host Oklahoma State · Greiner Family OSU XC Course
headline: Big 12: BYU, Oklahoma State and Colorado meet for the title
summary: Three top-5 men’s teams meet in Stillwater: No. 2 Oklahoma State, No. 3 Colorado and No. 5 BYU. On the women’s side, No. 1 BYU faces No. 3 West Virginia, No. 7 Oklahoma State and No. 10 Colorado. The women’s 6K starts at 10:00 a.m. CT and the men’s 8K at 11:00 a.m. CT, on ESPN.
